python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import os
os.chdir('/Users/guillaumeloulier/PhpstormProjects/oss/elephc/.claude/worktrees/streams-csv-signature')
p='src/codegen_support/runtime/io/stream_select.rs'
s=open(p).read()
old='''    let cast_done_l = format!("__rt_stream_select_build_{}_cast_done", suffix);'''
new='''    let cast_done_l = format!("__rt_stream_select_build_{}_cast_done", suffix);
    let cast_ok_l = format!("__rt_stream_select_build_{}_cast_ok", suffix);'''
assert s.count(old)==1
s=s.replace(old,new)
old='''    emitter.instruction("b.ne __rt_stream_select_cast_ok");'''
new='''    emitter.instruction(&format!("b.ne {}", cast_ok_l));'''
assert s.count(old)==1
s=s.replace(old,new)
old='''    emitter.label("__rt_stream_select_cast_ok");'''
new='''    emitter.label(&cast_ok_l);'''
assert s.count(old)==1
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
print('label suffixed per section')
PYEOF
